detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

CJC-1295

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C152H252N44O42
  • Molecular Weight: 3367.99 g/mol
  • Sequence: Tyr-D-Ala-Asp-Ala-Ile-Phe-Thr-Gln-Ser-Tyr-Arg-Lys-Val-Leu-Ala-Gln-Leu-Ser-Ala-Arg-Lys-Leu-Leu-Gln-Asp-Ile-Leu-Ser-Arg
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

CJC-1295 (no DAC) is a synthetic peptide composed of a defined amino acid sequence produced through controlled peptide synthesis. It is structurally characterized and utilized in laboratory research settings for analytical and experimental evaluation under controlled conditions. The compound is supplied in lyophilized powder form to support stability and integrity during storage and handling in research environments.

Research Applications:

CJC-1295 (no DAC) is utilized in controlled laboratory research settings for applications such as:

  • Analytical evaluation of peptide structure and sequence characteristics
  • Examination of peptide stability and degradation profiles under defined conditions
  • Investigation of peptide behavior in biochemical and cell-based assay systems
  • Characterization of peptide interactions within controlled experimental models
Storage and Handling:
  • Store the lyophilized powder at -20°C.
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2-8°C and use promptly.
  • Maintain aseptic handling practices to ensure product quality and sterility.
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

CJC-1295 (no DAC) is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
